e

q-98659.name: Question 2
q-98659.worked_solution:
The range of $\sqrt[6]{x}$ is

$$
\sqrt[6]{x}\ge 0.
$$

Horizontal shifts and stretches do not affect the range. Hence,

$$
\sqrt[6]{4-3x}\ge 0.
$$

Multiplying the above inequality by $-4$ and then adding $2,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[6]{4-3x} & \ge 0 \\ -4\sqrt[6]{4-3x} & \le 0 \\ -4\sqrt[6]{4-3x}+2 & \le 2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the range of the given function is $f(x)\in (-\infty ,2].$

We can also see that this is true from the graph of the function. The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown below.

What is the range of f(x)=−44−3x6+2?

a
 y∈(−∞,∞)

c
 y∈(−∞,43]
d
 y∈[43,∞)
e
 y∈(−∞,2]
Submit
Correct

x6≥0.

Horizontal shifts and stretches do not affect the range. Hence,

4−3x6≥0.

Multiplying the above inequality by −4 and then adding 2, we get

4−3x6≥0−44−3x6≤0−44−3x6+2≤2.

Therefore, the range of the given function is f(x)∈(−∞,2].

q-115847.worked_solution:
The range of $\sqrt[4]{x}$ is

$$
\sqrt[4]{x}\ge 0.
$$

Horizontal shifts and stretches do not affect the range. Hence,

$$
\sqrt[4]{2x-7}\ge 0.

Multiplying the above inequality by $-3$ and then adding $2,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[4]{2x-7} & \ge 0 \\ -3\sqrt[4]{2x-7} & \le 0 \\ -3\sqrt[4]{2x-7}+2 & \le 2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the range of the given function is $f(x)\in (-\infty ,2].$

Question 3
?

What is the range of f(x)=−32x−74+2?

a
y∈(−∞,72]
b
y∈[2,∞)
c
y∈[72,∞)
d
y∈(−∞,∞)
e
y∈(−∞,2]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The range of x4 is

x4≥0.

Horizontal shifts and stretches do not affect the range. Hence,

2x−74≥0.

Multiplying the above inequality by −3 and then adding 2, we get

2x−74≥0−32x−74≤0−32x−74+2≤2.

Therefore, the range of the given function is f(x)∈(−∞,2].
